task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First, it would be a great idea if you could look and see that the door is open. After that, attempt to venture north. With that accomplished, go to the west. With that done, try to take a trip north. And then, make an effort to venture north. And then, pick up the latchkey from the floor of the studio. Once that's all handled, you can stop!

You see an opened locker. The locker is empty! This is the worst thing that could possibly happen, ever!
